Main:
CALL 检查Benchmark文件占用
System.RunApplication.RunApplication ApplicationPath: $'''D:\\yonwork\\YonWork.exe''' WindowStyle: System.ProcessWindowStyle.Maximized ProcessId=> AppProcessId
Excel.LaunchExcel.LaunchAndOpenUnderExistingProcess Path: ExcelPath Visible: False ReadOnly: False UseMachineLocale: False Instance=> ExcelInstance
IF ModelMode = $'''NewAPI''' THEN
    SET model TO $'''deepseek-flash(NewAPI)'''
ELSE
    SET model TO $'''YonWork默认模型'''
END
SET FlowSucceeded TO False
BLOCK 主流程保护
ON BLOCK ERROR

END
    CALL 读取提示词列表
    LOOP FOREACH CurrentCase IN CasesTable
        SET CaseName TO CurrentCase['CaseName']
        SET prompt TO CurrentCase['Prompt']
        SET Runs TO CurrentCase['Runs']
        SET Enabled TO CurrentCase['Enabled']
        DISABLE Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Title: $'''test''' Message: $'''%CaseName%
%Enabled%''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed
        IF Enabled = True THEN
            LOOP LoopIndex FROM 1 TO Runs STEP 1
                SET RunNo TO LoopIndex
                IF ModelMode = $'''YonWorkDefault''' THEN
                    DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> UsageBeginTime
                    Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: UsageBeginTime CustomFormat: $'''yyyyMMdd-HHmmss''' Result=> UsageTimestamp
                    SET BenchmarkId TO $'''%CaseName%-Run%RunNo%-%UsageTimestamp%'''
                    Scripting.RunPowershellScript.RunScript Script: $'''$result = & python \"%YonWorkUsageScript%\" begin `
    --benchmark-id \"%BenchmarkId%\" `
    --log-path \"%YonWorkLogPath%\"

$result''' ScriptOutput=> YonWorkUsageBeginOutput
                END
                CALL 执行YonWork单次测试
                CALL 保存通用数据
                IF ModelMode = $'''NewAPI''' THEN
                    WAIT 2
                    CALL 获取NewAPI统计
                    CALL 保存NewAPI数据
                ELSE
                    CALL 获取YonWork默认模型统计
                    CALL 保存YonWork默认模型数据
                END
            END
        END
    END
    SET FlowSucceeded TO True
END
ERROR => LastError
IF FlowSucceeded = True THEN
    SET ExcelClosed TO False
    BLOCK 正常保存关闭Excel
ON BLOCK ERROR

END
        Excel.CloseExcel.CloseAndSave Instance: ExcelInstance
        SET ExcelClosed TO True
    END
    IF ExcelClosed = False THEN
        CALL 强制清理Excel
    END
ELSE
    DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> ErrorTime
    File.WriteText File: $'''C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Desktop\\benchmark\\yonwork_error.log''' TextToWrite: $'''[%ErrorTime%] Case=%CaseName% Run=%RunNo% | 子流程=%LastError.SubflowName% | 动作=%LastError.ActionName% | 序号=%LastError.ActionIndex% | 错误=%LastError.Message%''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
    SET ExcelClosed TO False
    BLOCK 异常不保存关闭Excel
ON BLOCK ERROR

END
        Excel.CloseExcel.Close Instance: ExcelInstance
        SET ExcelClosed TO True
    END
    IF ExcelClosed = False THEN
        CALL 强制清理Excel
    END
END
Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Title: $'''done''' Message: $'''流程结束！''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: True ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed3

检查Benchmark文件占用:

Scripting.RunPowershellScript.RunScript Script: $'''$path = \"%ExcelPath%\"

try {
    $stream = [System.IO.File]::Open(
        $path,
        [System.IO.FileMode]::Open,
        [System.IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite,
        [System.IO.FileShare]::None
    )

    $stream.Close()
    Write-Output \"FREE\"
}
catch {
    Write-Output \"LOCKED\"
}''' ScriptOutput=> FileLockStatus
Text.Trim Text: FileLockStatus TrimOption: Text.TrimOption.Both TrimmedText=> FileLockStatusTrimmed
IF FileLockStatusTrimmed = $'''LOCKED''' THEN
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Title: $'''Benchmark 文件被占用''' Message: $'''yonwork_benchmark.xlsx 当前被 Excel/WPS 占用。

是否强制关闭所有 Excel / WPS 表格进程并继续运行？
未保存的其他表格可能会丢失。''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.YesNo DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: True ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed
    IF ButtonPressed = $'''Yes''' THEN
        CALL 强制清理Excel
        WAIT 1
        Scripting.RunPowershellScript.RunScript Script: $'''$path = \"%ExcelPath%\"

try {
    $stream = [System.IO.File]::Open(
        $path,
        [System.IO.FileMode]::Open,
        [System.IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite,
        [System.IO.FileShare]::None
    )

    $stream.Close()
    Write-Output \"FREE\"
}
catch {
    Write-Output \"LOCKED\"
}''' ScriptOutput=> FileLockStatus
        Text.Trim Text: FileLockStatus TrimOption: Text.TrimOption.Both TrimmedText=> FileLockStatusTrimmed
        IF FileLockStatusTrimmed = $'''LOCKED''' THEN
            Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Title: $'''error''' Message: $'''清理失败！''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed2
            EXIT Code: 0
        END
    ELSE
        EXIT Code: 0
    END
END


读取提示词列表:
Excel.SetActiveWorksheet.ActivateWorksheetByName Instance: ExcelInstance Name: PromptList
Excel.ReadFromExcel.ReadAllCells Instance: ExcelInstance GetCellContentsMode: Excel.GetCellContentsMode.TypedValues FirstLineIsHeader: True RangeValue=> CasesTable

执行YonWork单次测试:


FUNCTION 执行YonWork单次测试 GLOBAL
    UIAutomation.Click.Click Element: appmask['Window \'YonWork\'']['Hyperlink \'新建任务\''] ClickType: UIAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MousePositionRelativeToElement: UIAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
    DISABLE UIAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField TextField: appmask['Window \'YonWork\'']['Edit \'yc-composer-area yc-rich-composer-area\''] Text: prompt Mode: UIAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace ClickType: UIAutomation.PopulateMouseClickType.SingleClick
    Clipboard.SetText Text: prompt
    UIAutomation.Click.Click Element: appmask['Window \'YonWork\'']['Edit \'yc-composer-area yc-rich-composer-area\''] ClickType: UIAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MousePositionRelativeToElement: UIAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
    MouseAndKeyboard.SendKeys.FocusAndSendKeys TextToSend: $'''{Control}({V})''' DelayBetweenKeystrokes: 10 SendTextAsHardwareKeys: False
    WAIT 0.5
    UIAutomation.PressButton Button: appmask['Window \'YonWork\'']['Button \'发送\''] Simulate: False
    DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> StartTime
    WAIT (UIAutomation.WaitForWindowContent.WindowToContainElement Element: appmask['Window \'YonWork\'']['Button \'停止\''])
    WAIT (UIAutomation.WaitForWindowContent.WindowToNotContainElement Element: appmask['Window \'YonWork\'']['Button \'停止\''])
    DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> EndTime
    DateTime.Subtract FromDate: EndTime SubstractDate: StartTime TimeUnit: DateTime.DifferenceTimeUnit.Seconds TimeDifference=> DurationSeconds
END FUNCTION

END FUNCTION

获取YonWork默认模型统计：

FUNCTION 获取YonWork默认模型统计 GLOBAL
    Scripting.RunPowershellScript.RunScript Script: $'''$json = & python \"%YonWorkUsageScript%\" collect `
    --benchmark-id \"%BenchmarkId%\" `
    --timeout 10

$obj = $json | ConvertFrom-Json

if (-not $obj.success) {
    throw \"$($obj.errorCode): $($obj.message)\"
}

Write-Output \"$($obj.runInputTokens)|$($obj.runOutputTokens)|$($obj.runTotalTokens)\"''' ScriptOutput=> YonWorkUsageCollectOutput
    Text.SplitText.SplitWithDelimiter Text: YonWorkUsageCollectOutput CustomDelimiter: $'''|''' IsRegEx: False Result=> YonWorkUsageList
    Text.ToNumber Text: YonWorkUsageList[0] Number=> InputTokens
    Text.ToNumber Text: YonWorkUsageList[1] Number=> OutputTokens
    Text.ToNumber Text: YonWorkUsageList[2] Number=> TotalTokens
END FUNCTION
